disorder-name.detail: Self-limited epilepsy with centrotemporal spikes clinical cohort
disorder-name.supporting_text: The casecontrol cohort comprised 187 children with SeLECTS, including 98 boys and 89 girls, aged 4 to 18 years, with a mean age of 9.09 ± 2.66 years (mean ± SD).

dataset-of-origin.detail: Clinical cohort scanned at Jinling Hospital (single-site case-control cohort).
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: Structural images were acquired on a Siemens Trio Tim 3.0tesla MRI scanner at Jinling Hospital.
